subject.title: fix(web-media): add timeoutMs option to WebMediaOptions for remote fetches

question: Should Tlon use a 120-second or 15-minute response-header deadline, and which open PR should own the fix?
rationale: Both durations correctly bound the same stall but intentionally trade off failure latency against compatibility with unusually slow response headers; repository history does not establish a Tlon-specific duration contract.

options.title: Use 120 seconds
options.body: Confirm and land the narrow proof-positive implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104132, aligning Tlon with the established channel-media header deadline.

options.title: Use 15 minutes
options.body: Retain this PR only if the Tlon owner explicitly approves the longer envelope and direct proof is added through both changed workflows.

recommendation.title: Use 120 seconds
recommendation.body: Confirm and land the narrow proof-positive implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104132, aligning Tlon with the established channel-media header deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and merged the existing Tlon media timeout behavior, providing the strongest concrete history signal for choosing its next failure boundary.
